channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Artistas podem impedir candidatos de usarem suas músicas? Entenda
item.description: The use of songs in electoral campaigns can generate controversies, such as the case of Frejat, who repudiated the use of 'Bete Balanço' in Renan Santos (MBL) campaign. Brazilian legislation allows the use of musical works in campaigns only with prior authorization from copyright holders, including composers and publishers. Parodies and adaptations also require legal attention, as not every lyric modification is considered legal.

item.title: Os redutos de Flávio e Lula em MG no 1º turno e onde tiveram menor votação
item.description: In the first round of the 2026 elections in Minas Gerais, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) received 5,777,548 votes, surpassing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), who got 5,188,936, with a margin of 588,612 votes. Lula had stronger support in Northern Minas and the Jequitinhonha Valley, while Flávio led in the South and Center-West. The most polarized municipalities include Guaraciama, where Lula reached 77.71% of the vote, and Monte Sião, where Flávio scored 74.66%.

item.title: Pauta do Senado, impeachment de Moraes é foco de deputado mais votado de SP
item.description: Lucas Pavanato (PL), the most-voted federal deputy in São Paulo, prioritizes the impeachment of Minister Alexandre de Moraes and limiting the powers of the Supreme Court. He also supports lowering the age of criminal responsibility, ending reelection, and reducing electoral populism.

item.title: Seleção Brasileira Feminina enfrenta Argentina em amistoso no Beira-Rio
item.description: The Brazilian Women's National Team begins its 2026 friendly schedule with matches against Argentina, including a game at the Beira-Rio Stadium. The team aims to build momentum after winning the FIFA Series title in April. Carol Gil was called up to replace Thais Ferreira to strengthen the squad.

item.title: A banda passou na janela e só Lula não viu
item.description: Lula blamed his first-round loss on inadequate communication to showcase his achievements, without considering that voters may have understood but rejected his legacy. His self-criticism avoids questioning whether public acceptance was truly a campaign issue.

item.title: Corra, Lula, corra
item.description: The article provides a political analysis focused on the upcoming runoff election, highlighting Lula as a candidate and criticizing his opponent for a history of corruption, unfulfilled promises, and divisive positions. It also discusses issues such as education, indigenous rights, representation, and social polarization, suggesting the opponent poses a risk to democracy.

item.title: O jogo dos sete erros do PT
item.description: The article analyzes the PT's potential strategy in the 2026 elections, suggesting the party may repeat similar mistakes from 2022 by underestimating the strength of candidates like Flávio Bolsonaro. It notes that the vote difference between Flávio and Lula in the first round resembles the margin that decided the previous election, indicating risks of repeating miscalculations.

item.title: Grupo de token pró-Flávio briga após prejuízos, cobra compradores e tira política de site até eleição
item.description: A pro-Bolsonaro token group behind the B22 cryptocurrency clashed after reporting financial losses. The asset's promoters and buyers are exchanging accusations and have decided to remove all political content from the website until the 2026 elections.

item.title: Dança das cadeiras: quais partidos ganharam e quais perderam espaço no Congresso Nacional
item.description: The 2026 elections reshaped congressional seats, with the PL expanding its caucus in the Chamber of Deputies (121 deputies) and the Senate (28 senators) to become the largest parliamentary force. Traditional parties like PSD, União Brasil, PSDB, and Cidadania (now without deputies) suffered major losses.

item.title: De desilusão com a política a viagens: abstenção nas eleições de 2026 é a maior desde 1998
item.description: Voter turnout in the 2026 elections dropped to 21.08%, the highest abstention rate since 1998, with 33 million eligible voters not participating in the first round. Voter apathy and political polarization between Lula and Bolsonaro were cited as key reasons, along with bureaucratic barriers and lack of accessibility.

item.title: Especialistas veem caráter eleitoreiro em medida do governo sobre combustíveis
item.description: With 16 days to the runoff, the Lula administration expanded fuel subsidies, eliminating PIS/Cofins and Cide taxes, giving consumers R$ 0,89 off per liter. Measures also cover diesel and ethanol, costing R$ 5,2 billion in public funds. Analysts see an electoral motive in the subsidy expansion.

item.title: TSE manda suspender site que oferece criptomoedas por apoio a Flávio
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court ordered the suspension of a website that offered cryptocurrencies in exchange for posts favoring presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, deeming it an economic advantage during the electoral period. The measure was proposed by Lula's campaign following a complaint to the Electoral Prosecutor's Office. Bolsonaro's campaign denied involvement and announced a lawsuit to take down the site.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro terá feriado com compromissos em SP e Brasília
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), candidate for reelection to the Presidency, will attend political and religious events in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and Brasília during the extended holiday of Our Lady of Aparecida, including a lunch with local officials and participation in religious celebrations.

item.title: Kassio baixa regra para acelerar análise de ações de propaganda no TSE após críticas
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques implemented rules to expedite analysis of electoral advertising before the second round. These changes aim to streamline processes and reduce criticism of the electoral judicial system.

item.title: Resultado da eleição redefine fila de cotados ao STF com Flávio Bolsonaro ou Lula
item.description: The 2026 election result reshaped the competition for the power to appoint justices to the STF (Supreme Federal Court), with either Flávio Bolsonaro or Lula emerging as potential presidential candidates. The winner will be able to reshape the court with at least four new appointments, influencing the lineup of candidates and responding to pressure for changes in the court's composition following the right-wing consolidation of a Senate majority.

item.title: Perfis pró-Flávio no Brasil e no exterior expuseram eleitores de Lula e incentivaram denúncias
item.description: Pro-Flávio Bolsonaro profiles in Brazil and abroad mobilized supporters to expose and encourage reports against overseas Lula voters during and after the first round of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Mobilização online pró-Lula liga alerta na campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro, que contra-ataca
item.description: Pro-Lula online mobilization raised alarms in Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, which retaliated with counter-offensives on WhatsApp. The digital confrontation intensified in the weeks leading up to the 2026 elections.

item.title: Favoritismo de Flávio Bolsonaro põe em xeque reeleição de Motta e Alcolumbre, e centrão se movimenta
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's favoritism within the PL party threatens the re-election of Hugo Motta and Davi Alcolumbre, as center-right parties compete for positions in the Chamber and Senate. The PL aims to take over at least one of the congressional chambers by February 2027.

item.title: Segundo turno tem guerra judicial com ordens de ministros contra Lula e ação do PT contra Flávio
item.description: The election race between Lula and Flávio Dino enters the final stretch of the second round with intense legal battles at the TSE, involving lawsuits and court orders against both candidates. The PT is also filing legal actions against Flávio, while the judiciary closely watches the campaigns.

item.title: Mulher de Flávio diz que “inventar mentiras” é diferente de discordar
item.description: Fernanda Bolsonaro defended her husband, Flávio Bolsonaro, on Instagram Stories, distinguishing democratic criticism from lies, and urged followers to check official campaign sources. She also shared personal details and promoted the 'Flávio com a Verdade' website.

item.title: Estela Aranha manda suspender site que oferece criptomoedas por apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE minister Estela Aranha ordered the suspension of a website that offered cryptocurrencies to users who supported Flávio Bolsonaro. Flávio's campaign denied involvement, claiming they were unaware of the site's authorship and vowed legal action. The case was reported by Lula's coalition to the TSE.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Datafolha mostra a disputa Flávio x Lula no segundo turno
item.description: A new Datafolha poll examines the 2026 presidential race, focusing on a potential Flávio Bolsonaro vs. Lula runoff. The survey covers voting intentions, voter decisiveness, candidate rejection, government approval, and public opinions on political and social issues.

item.title: Camilo Santana diz que estratégia de campanha é comparar biografias e lembrar população sobre como foi governo Bolsonaro
item.description: Camilo Santana, campaign coordinator for Lula, states that the re-election strategy will focus on comparing biographies and governments, highlighting Lula's administration and criticizing Bolsonaro's. He emphasizes security, health, and education as strengths of Lula's government, while pointing out insecurity and unemployment during Bolsonaro's term.

item.title: PT faz cinco ações contra divulgação de áudio atribuído a Vorcaro
item.description: Lula and Alckmin's campaign disputes the authenticity of an audio attributed to Daniel Vorcaro, accusing the banker of irregular payments to PT. The party filed lawsuits with the TSE and federal court demanding investigations, audio forensics, and moral damages against Veja magazine. Vorcaro has been detained since March and rejected two plea bargain proposals.

item.title: Padilha sugere que Vorcaro atua para beneficiar Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Minister of Health Alexandre Padilha questioned in a video whether Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro is acting to benefit senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential race, following a Veja magazine report on alleged payments to fund a film about Lula. The Attorney General's Office and Federal Police deny that Vorcaro gave testimony with the described content, and his defense says it does not confirm the authenticity of the audio. Flávio Bolsonaro had previously requested $24 million from Vorcaro to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Fachin nega pedido de Fux e diz que pretende arquivar inquérito das Fake News
item.description: The President of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), Edson Fachin, told Minister Luiz Fux that he intends to permanently close the Fake News inquiry, an investigation opened in 2018 against former President Jair Bolsonaro. Fachin took over the case from Alexandre de Moraes and noted that 108 investigative procedures are linked to the inquiry, which must be analyzed before closure.

item.title: Justiça derruba decisão que liberou operação de plataforma de apostas
item.description: The 3rd Regional Federal Court annulled the injunction that authorized the operation of the online betting platform Stake Brasil, following a request from the Attorney General's Office. The judge argued that allowing only one company to operate while others are restricted creates regulatory asymmetry. The constitutionality of the provisional measure banning online betting is being challenged at the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: O destino dos votos da terceira via no segundo turno entre Flávio e Lula, segundo diretor de instituto de pesquisa
item.description: Yuri Sanches of AtlasIntel assesses that third-way votes tend to favor Flávio Bolsonaro due to the conservative profile of voters from Zema and Caiado, while Lula seeks support among centrist and urban groups. The vote transfer is not automatic and depends on the campaign's ability to attract voters from candidates like Cury and Renan.

item.title: TSE suspende site que dava criptomoeda em troca de propaganda de Flávio
item.description: The TSE suspended the 'Brasil 22 Token' website that distributed cryptocurrencies in exchange for supportive posts about Flávio Bolsonaro. The decision was made following reports of irregularities in the electoral campaign, indicating potential abuse of economic power to influence voters.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro acusa Lula de receber propina de Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused Lula of receiving bribes from Vorcaro, but the PT campaign rejected the accusation. The controversy involves an audio attributed to the former banker, who allegedly funded a documentary about Lula illicitly. The PGR archived the investigation for lack of evidence.

item.title: Gabi Guimarães, do vôlei, apoia reeleição de Lula: "Não podemos retroceder"
item.description: Volleyball player Gabi Guimarães endorsed Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for re-election in the 2026 Brazilian elections' second round, emphasizing the need to preserve democracy, diversity, and minority rights. Through a social media video, she expressed pride in representing Brazil and stated the country cannot afford to regress on democratic and social values.

item.title: Fachin defende reforma do Judiciário sem enfraquecer magistratura
item.description: The president of the STF, Edson Fachin, defended the modernization of the Judiciary without weakening the magistracy, emphasizing the importance of involving judges in the reform and preserving their constitutional guarantees. He stressed that the independence of magistrates is a guarantee for society and that reform must be done with the Judiciary, not against it. Fachin also announced the creation of a study group to propose improvements to the justice system, with a deadline in November.

item.title: Carlos Jordy: ‘Davi Alcolumbre foi um péssimo presidente do Senado’
item.description: Elected senator Carlos Jordy (PL-RJ) criticized Davi Alcolumbre, claiming he was a poor Senate president for failing to defend the National Congress against the STF. He endorsed Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) as his preferred candidate for the Senate presidency, stressing the need for the Legislative branch to regain independence. The dispute also involves the non-installation of the Banco Master CPI, which Jordy supports.

item.title: TSE manda derrubar site que oferecia criptomoedas por posts pró-Flávio
item.description: The Brazilian Superior Electoral Court ordered the removal of the Brasil 22 Token website, which offered cryptocurrencies in exchange for pro-Flávio Bolsonaro posts. The decision was based on suspected irregular electoral advertising and breach of campaign regulations.

item.title: Datafolha: viagem, saúde, desinteresse e trabalho são os principais motivos do eleitor para não votar no 1º turno
item.description: Datafolha poll shows record voter absenteeism in 2026 at 21%, with travel, health, and disinterest as top reasons. Flavio Bolsonaro leads the 2nd round with 49% against Lula's 45%, while 43% expect life to remain the same if Lula wins, and 36% believe it will improve under Flavio.

item.title: TSE suspende site que oferece criptomoeda a quem divulgar conteúdo que defende voto em Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The TSE suspended the 'Brasil 22 Token' website after investigating the offer of cryptocurrencies to individuals spreading pro-FlaRou Bolsnoaro political content, deeming the scheme a mechanism of economic advantage tied to electoral campaigns. The action was filed by Lula's coalition and points to possible abuse of economic power and misuse of communication. Posts involved Ugandan children and mentioned Flavio Bolsonaro, Nikolaus Ferreira, and Pablo Marcal.

item.title: Toffoli nega ao PL acesso a documentos sobre jantar de Lula com empresários
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli denied the PL access to documents about a dinner between Lula and businessmen, considering it part of electoral dynamics and protected by constitutional freedoms. The court ruled the party provided no concrete evidence of irregularities.

item.title: Vorcaro diz ter pago R$ 30 milhões por fora ao filme do Lula
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, claims to the PGR that he paid 30 million off-the-books to the Lula Institute to fund Oliver Stone's documentary about Lula. According to magazine Veja, the money would have been a quid pro quo for Banco Master's entry into state pension funds.

item.title: Lula tenta recuperar votos com viagens a SP e Rio na próxima semana
item.description: Lula travels to Sao Paulo and Rio to recover votes in the Southeast, with events for truckers and healthcare workers, plus an interview with TV Globo. The campaign aims to offset the vote loss in 2026 compared to 2022.

item.title: Brasileirão: distância entre 2° e 3° é maior do que entre candidatos ao Z4
item.description: After round 29 of the Brazilian Championship, the top of the table remains tightly contested, with Palmeiras leading at 60 points while Flamengo (51) and Fluminense (51) apply pressure. In the relegation zone, Internacional leads the relegation zone with 30 points, and six teams are within two wins of the drop. The direct clashes in round 30 are expected to produce key outcomes at both ends of the table.

item.title: Flávio propõe superministério social com Bolsa Família e 'nova mentalidade'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) announced on the premiere of his TV show the creation of a Ministry of Prosperity, a social super-ministry combining Bolsa Família with a push for a 'new mindset'. The proposal, disclosed on September 9, positions the former senator as a leading figure in social affairs heading into the 2026 elections.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro já consta em banco de mandados de prisão abertos
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) has a definitive arrest warrant issued by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes for conviction of coercion, sentenced to 4 years and 2 months of imprisonment. The arrest order was forwarded to the Federal Police for execution, including passport cancellation and analysis of loss of public office. Since February 2025, Bolsonaro has been living abroad with a U.S. green card, claiming to escape political persecution.

item.title: Crianças de Uganda se desculpam por vídeo com referência a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Children from the Ugandan dance group Hypers Kids Africa apologized on Instagram after promoting a cryptocurrency platform linked to Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, sparking controversy in Brazil. The platform offered tokens to users who supported the senator's candidacy, but the team claimed no payment was received and deleted the videos to avoid political involvement. The incident was criticized for indirectly involving international support for Bolsonaro's campaign.

item.title: Estudantes fazem atos pelo país em apoio a Lula
item.description: Students from 13 states and the Federal District held protests in support of Lula, emphasizing public education, democracy, and human rights. The National Union of Students (UNE) led the demonstrations, with actions in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and Tocantins. Supporters stressed the importance of not regressing on social and political rights.

item.title: Cleitinho diz que Flávio se comprometeu a renegociar dívida de MG com a União caso seja eleito
item.description: Elected governor of Minas Gerais, Cleitinho Azevedo, stated that Flávio Bolsonaro committed to renegotiating the state's R$200 billion debt with the federal government if elected president. The proposal includes redirecting debt payment funds toward infrastructure and public security projects in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Alcolumbre pauta votação do fim da escala 6 X 1 para 14 de outubro
item.description: The Senate will hold the first vote on the PEC ending the 6 X 1 work schedule on October 14, requiring support from 49 senators in two rounds. The legislative process faces scheduling challenges for President Lula's government ahead of the 2026 elections. The proposal establishes a 40-hour weekly work schedule without salary reduction.

item.title: Bolsonaro apresentou quadro de taquicardia antes do 1º turno, diz boletim
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro experienced tachycardia and dyspnea on the eve of the 2026 election's first round, according to a medical report. Despite the episode, he is stable but experiencing medication side effects. Bolsonaro has been under house arrest since March 2026 for humanitarian reasons.

item.title: O STF não resolveu. Agora, o Congresso terá a palavra
item.description: The STF did not take a definitive stance on the investigation of a justice, leaving the matter to Congress. With the right wing nearing a majority in the Senate, the parliamentary landscape may influence decisions regarding ministerial oversight.

item.title: Datafolha: eleitores escolheram voto para governador, senador e deputados mais cedo
item.description: A Datafolha survey from 2026 indicates that more voters are deciding their choices for governor, senator, and deputies earlier than in the 2022 elections. Most respondents selected their candidates at least one month before Election Day, with fewer voters making last-minute decisions.

item.title: Flávio nega intenção de acabar com o Bolsa Família
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, a candidate from the PL party, denied on Friday, 9th, any intention to cut the Bolsa Família program, labeling the claims as 'lies'. Following a meeting with Fluminense politicians, the senator rejected circulating rumors about his future administration.
